visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with glowing, clear skin smiles into the camera, touching her cheeks with both hands. She has dark brown hair and is wearing off-the-shoulder white clothing and a watch. The setting is a warmly lit indoor bedroom. (2) A variety of skincare products from the brand LEBELAGE are displayed on a shelf, including a cleanser with a brush, toner pads, a serum bottle, and several mask boxes. (3) The woman holds the LEBELAGE foam cleanser, which has an orange bottle and a white brush head. She demonstrates the pump action, producing white foam, and then uses the brush to massage the foam onto her cheeks in circular motions. (4) She sits at a desk and opens a green jar of toner pads. She uses a pair of plastic tweezers to pick up a single pad, then wipes it across her face before sticking two pads onto her cheeks as a mini-mask. (5) She holds an orange serum bottle with a dropper. She applies the clear liquid directly onto her face and massages it in with her hands, highlighting the glossy texture of her skin. (6) She opens a sheet mask packet and applies a white, perforated sheet mask to her face, smoothing it out. (7) Finally, she is seen lying in bed with a different sheet mask on, then peels it off to reveal radiant skin. She smiles and poses with the full product set.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice begins narration in an upbeat, enthusiastic tone over a rhythmic, bright pop BGM track. No significant SFX are present initially. (2) A sharp mechanical click sound occurs as the user presses the pump of the facial cleanser. The narration continues smoothly, describing the product's benefits. (3) A subtle rustling sound of a plastic mask packet being opened is audible as the narrator mentions the sheet mask. The BGM remains consistent in volume and tempo. (4) Soft tapping or sliding sounds are heard as the toner jar is handled, followed by the narration listing ingredients like B5 and Centella. (5) A final bright synthesizer chord signals the end of the video, overlapping with the closing brand tagline and the narrator's positive final remark.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Step-by-step Demonstration -> Result/Benefit -> Brand Logo
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comprehensive product endorsement and tutorial for the LEBELAGE skincare line. It aims to showcase the effectiveness of several products (cleanser, toner pads, serum, masks) in achieving clear, stable, and glowing skin through a systematic routine. The use of a relatable creator and detailed close-ups serves to build trust and demonstrate product texture and usage.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Frequent display of the brand logo LEBELAGE, direct verbal recommendation, and step-by-step product demonstration.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality social media beauty content utilizing fast-paced editing and bright, warm lighting to appeal to a younger demographic interested in skincare routines.
